spainSection.title: The European Regulation, applied to Spain
spainSection.aesiaBody: The Spanish AI Supervision Agency is the national reference authority for market surveillance of AI systems in Spain.
spainSection.sandboxBody: Spain piloted the EU's first controlled AI testing environment, a reference framework for understanding how high-risk systems will be supervised.
spainSection.aepdBody: If your business handles health data (dental clinics, medical centers), that data is a special category under the GDPR and LOPDGDD, with reinforced requirements beyond the AI Act.

healthDataAlert.title: Health data detected
healthDataAlert.body: Your sector handles health data, a special category under Article 9 GDPR and the LOPDGDD. Beyond the AI Act, you need a reinforced legal basis, and in many cases a data protection impact assessment (DPIA), before using AI on this data.

aiLiteracyNote.title: Cross-cutting obligation: AI literacy
aiLiteracyNote.body: Since February 2, 2025, Article 4 of the Regulation requires staff who use or oversee AI systems to have adequate training, regardless of risk level.

results.disclaimer: This classification is indicative and based on the answers provided. It does not replace advice from a legal professional.

AI_LITERACY.label: Train staff on AI use
AI_LITERACY.description: Make sure people who use or oversee the system understand its capabilities, limitations and risks.

PROHIBITED_STOP_USE.label: Stop using this practice immediately
PROHIBITED_STOP_USE.description: The Regulation prohibits this practice except in very limited exceptions. Consult a legal professional before continuing.

HIGH_RISK_DEPLOYER_OBLIGATIONS.label: Meet deployer obligations
HIGH_RISK_DEPLOYER_OBLIGATIONS.description: Use the system according to the provider's instructions, monitor its operation, and keep the automatically generated logs.

HIGH_RISK_HUMAN_OVERSIGHT.label: Assign effective human oversight
HIGH_RISK_HUMAN_OVERSIGHT.description: Designate someone with the real ability to review, pause or correct the system's decisions.

HIGH_RISK_LOGGING.label: Retain operation logs
HIGH_RISK_LOGGING.description: Keep the automatically generated logs for the required period, so you can demonstrate compliant use of the system.

HIGH_RISK_FRIA.label: Assess the impact on fundamental rights
HIGH_RISK_FRIA.description: Before deploying the system, assess its impact on the rights of affected people (fundamental rights impact assessment).

TRANSPARENCY_DISCLOSE_AI.label: Disclose that people are interacting with AI
TRANSPARENCY_DISCLOSE_AI.description: Clearly indicate, before or during the interaction, that the person is talking to an AI system.

TRANSPARENCY_LABEL_SYNTHETIC.label: Label AI-generated content
TRANSPARENCY_LABEL_SYNTHETIC.description: Visibly or machine-readably mark images, video or audio generated or manipulated by AI.

TRANSPARENCY_EMOTION_NOTICE.label: Notify use of emotion recognition
TRANSPARENCY_EMOTION_NOTICE.description: Inform exposed individuals that the system analyzes their emotional state.

VOLUNTARY_CODE_CONDUCT.label: Adopt voluntary good practices
VOLUNTARY_CODE_CONDUCT.description: Although not mandatory, adhering to voluntary codes of conduct on transparency and responsible AI use is recommended.

warnings.WARN_VERIFY_EXCEPTION: Article 5 provides for very limited exceptions (e.g. medical or safety reasons). Confirm with a legal professional whether your case could be exempt before making any decision.
warnings.WARN_BIOMETRIC_VERIFICATION_SCOPE: If the system only verifies a person's identity (1:1 match, e.g. for clocking in), it may fall outside the strict definition of 'biometric identification'. Confirm with a legal professional to refine the classification.
warnings.WARN_HUMAN_REVIEW_RECOMMENDED: Adding human review before the decision takes effect reduces regulatory risk and improves customer trust.
warnings.WARN_GPAI_PROVIDER_OBLIGATIONS: The model provider (OpenAI, Microsoft or other) has its own obligations as a general-purpose AI provider. This does not remove your obligations as the business using the tool.

SPAIN_AESIA_INFO.label: AESIA is your reference authority
SPAIN_AESIA_INFO.description: The Spanish AI Supervision Agency oversees compliance with the Regulation in Spain. Keep this classification as part of your internal documentation.

SPAIN_AEPD_HEALTH.label: Health data: special category
SPAIN_AEPD_HEALTH.description: Patient data is a special category under Article 9 GDPR and the LOPDGDD. Review your legal basis and consider whether you need a data protection impact assessment (DPIA) before the AEPD.
